# goslop text fixture — pass-only generic catch after a JS interop probe try body
lang: python
file: js_bridge_pass.py
---
class RawIO:
    def __init__(self):
        self._reader = None
        self._response = None

    def _ensure_reader(self):
        if self._reader is None and self._response is not None:
            try:
                body = self._response.body
                if body is not None:
                    self._reader = body.getReader()
            except Exception:
                pass
